# P38.1a — Round-11 gap analysis, sub-rounds 11A + 11B (CAP-lite first half)

Independent, fresh-context re-read of every 11A + 11B row's declared acceptance
criteria against the landed evidence. This is the analysis artifact for manifest
row 501 (`docs/tickets/501_P38.1a__round11-gap-analysis-11a-11b.md`). Sibling
P38.1b (row 502) owns 11C + 11D and the composed two-sum completion; this file
carries only the 11A + 11B share. Read-only: `live_verification=false`, no
production mutation, no live leg executed by this row.

## 0. Method and independence

- Scope: BUILD_INDEX physical rows 201–343 inclusive — **143 rows** (60 rows in
  11A ending GATE-G4 row 260; 83 rows in 11B ending GATE-G5 row 343), including
  the inserted/split rows `287a` P35.1a1 (PR #296), `291a` P35.1c (PR #303),
  `320a` P35.41a (PR #339), and the plan/gate markers PLAN-11B (239), GATE-G4
  (260), PLAN-11C (340), GATE-G5 (343).
- Evidence re-read per row, not copied from the rows' own self-assessments:
  `docs/build/BUILD_INDEX.md` status cells; the per-ticket run ledgers under
  `docs/build/runs/`; `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` status cells; the obligation
  event chain `docs/build/reports/obligations/events.jsonl`; the committed
  RETURN PASS map `docs/build/tools/record_policy/return_pass.toml` and the
  generated RETURN PASS region of `docs/build/LEDGER.md`; head-bound CI boundary
  records under `docs/build/reports/ci/`; PHASE LOG entries; the acceptance
  reports `docs/build/reports/acceptance/11A.md` / `11B.md` and their probe-run
  records `11A-probe-run.json` / `11B-probe-run.json`.
- Verdict vocabulary per the ticket: `ACCEPTED` / `UNMET` / `OUT-OF-SCOPE` /
  `DEFERRED`, each labelled by its BM-STATUS-01 layer: `engineered`,
  `fixture-verified`, `staging-verified`, `live-executed`, `public`,
  `human-completed`, plus `committed-artifact`-verified (the packet-artifact
  class used by P35.62–P35.64).
- A row whose engineering landed under a head-bound green CI boundary is
  ACCEPTED at the landed layer; a live/public/human criterion whose leg or
  decision remains queued is `DEFERRED` — named by leg id / deferral id, never
  smoothed into the landed verdict.
